text_block_list.text:
To think I'd injure myself... This doesn't
bode well
at all, Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Well... no, the injury itself is nothing
serious. The
real problem is... it's a bad
sign for the future.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
An injury is a sign of grueling ordeals to
come!
This must be what the great
Shiraoki is trying to
warn me about!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Just imagining what kind of disasters will befall me gives me the shivers...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Well, let's take it easy for now.

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Just imagining what kind of disasters will befall me gives me the shivers...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Well, let's take it easy for now.

text_block_list.text:
You're right. The best thing to do at
times like
this is shut yourself awa—I
mean, stock up on
good luck.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
In which case, let's sprinkle purifying salt
and sake
all the way home for good
measure!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I definitely cannot show weakness! I'm
strong and
I'll be just fine... probably!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I don't have it in me! I'm not
strong
enough to do this!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I must be dripping with bad energy by
now!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Though only barely, it's seems I've bested my own weakness.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'll get to resting up and healing my
injuries! That
should ward off any bad
luck!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Now all I need is a lucky charm to help
speed up
my recovery!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару is burning with
determination
for our next training
session and concentrates all
her energy
toward recovery!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I tell her not to overdo it, and she takes
some
time to recuperate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All this commotion only negatively
impacts her
injury, and as a result, she
has to take a few days
off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
